title: AICK Thai Preprint — paper data
description: Structured-data input for org-templates/AICK/scripts/aick_generate.py, which renders a .tex file for the aick-thai-preprint.cls house class (see org-templates/AICK/source/). Field names map to the class's \AICK... metadata macros and to the body structure of aick-paper-template.tex.

title.description: Maps to \AICKTitle{...} -- the main title shown in large bold on page 1.

subtitle.description: Maps to \AICKSubtitle{...} -- an optional-in-the-class but required-here subtitle line under the title. Pass an empty string to omit it (the class already handles an empty \AICK@subtitle by not rendering the line).

author.description: Maps to \AICKAuthor{...} -- the full author name shown under the title, e.g. 'ชื่อผู้เขียน (English Name)'.

authorshort.description: Maps to \AICKAuthorShort{...} -- short author name/surname shown in the running header (fancyhdr, left).

orcid.description: Maps to \AICKORCID{...} -- bare ORCID id (e.g. 0000-0000-0000-0000). Pass an empty string to omit the orcidlink icon (the class already handles an empty \AICK@orcid).

affiliation.description: Maps to \AICKAffiliation{...} -- shown next to the author on page 1, e.g. 'Center for AI Civic Knowledge'.

shorttitle.description: Maps to \AICKShortTitle{...} -- short title shown in the running header (fancyhdr, right).

version.description: Maps to \AICKVersion{...} -- version tag shown near PREPRINT on page 1 and in the footer (e.g. 'v1.0').

date.description: Maps to \AICKDate{...} -- date string shown near PREPRINT on page 1, Thai-formatted (e.g. '20 กันยายน 2026').

abstract.description: Maps to \AICKAbstract{...} -- the abstract paragraph(s) rendered on page 1 under the gold rule, before the keywords line.

keywords.description: Maps to \AICKKeywords{...} -- a single string of keywords, semicolon-separated, rendered after 'คำสำคัญ:' on page 1.

methodology_note.description: Maps to the argument of \AICKMethodologyPage{...} -- the required page-2 methodological/status note (paper status, human-AI role disclosure, verification stance).

sections.description: Ordered body sections. Each entry becomes one \section{heading} followed by body on its own paragraph(s), starting on page 3 after the methodology page.

heading.description: Maps to the argument of \section{...} for this body section.

body.description: Maps to the paragraph text rendered directly under this \section{...}, verbatim (LaTeX-escaped only where the data itself contains no raw LaTeX).

acknowledgements.description: Optional. Maps to \AICKAcknowledgements{...}, rendered after the body sections if present. Omit the field (or leave it empty) to skip this end-matter block entirely.

declarations.description: Optional. Maps to \AICKDeclarations{...} (status/COI/data-availability statements), rendered after acknowledgements if present. Omit the field (or leave it empty) to skip this end-matter block entirely.

references.description: Optional. Each string becomes one \item inside the AICKReferences environment, rendered last. Omit the field (or leave it an empty array) to skip the references block entirely.

items.description: One full reference-list entry, rendered verbatim as the body of one \item.
